entries.title: Isaiah 13:1
segments: ¶The burden against Babylon which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:2
segments: "Lift up a banner on the high mountain, Raise your voice to them; Wave your hand, that they may enter the gates of the nobles.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:3
segments: I have commanded My sanctified ones; I have also called My mighty ones for My anger-Those who rejoice in My exaltation."

entries.title: Isaiah 13:4
segments: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, Like that of many people! A tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together! The LORD of hosts musters The army for battle.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:5
segments: They come from a far country, From the end of heaven-The LORD and His weapons of indignation, To destroy the whole land.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:6
segments: ¶Wail, for the day of the LORD [is] at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:7
segments: Therefore all hands will be limp, Every man's heart will melt,

entries.title: Isaiah 13:8
segments: And they will be afraid. Pangs and sorrows will take hold of [them]; They will be in pain as a woman in childbirth; They will be amazed at one another; Their faces [will be like] flames.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:9
segments: Behold, the day of the LORD comes, Cruel, with both wrath and fierce anger, To lay the land desolate; And He will destroy its sinners from it.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:10
segments: For the stars of heaven and their constellations Will not give their light; The sun will be darkened in its going forth, And the moon will not cause its light to shine.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:11
segments: "I will punish the world for [its] evil, And the wicked for their iniquity; I will halt the arrogance of the proud, And will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:12
segments: I will make a mortal more rare than fine gold, A man more than the golden wedge of Ophir.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:13
segments: Therefore I will shake the heavens, And the earth will move out of her place, In the wrath of the LORD of hosts And in the day of His fierce anger.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:14
segments: It shall be as the hunted gazelle, And as a sheep that no man takes up; Every man will turn to his own people, And everyone will flee to his own land.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:15
segments: Everyone who is found will be thrust through, And everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:16
segments: Their children also will be dashed to pieces before their eyes; Their houses will be plundered And their wives ravished.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:17
segments: "Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, Who will not regard silver; And [as for] gold, they will not delight in it.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:18
segments: Also [their] bows will dash the young men to pieces, And they will have no pity on the fruit of the womb; Their eye will not spare children.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:19
segments: ¶And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, The beauty of the Chaldeans' pride, Will be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:20
segments: It will never be inhabited, Nor will it be settled from generation to generation; Nor will the Arabian pitch tents there, Nor will the shepherds make their sheepfolds there.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:21
segments: But wild beasts of the desert will lie there, And their houses will be full of owls; Ostriches will dwell there, And wild goats will caper there.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:22
segments: The hyenas will howl in their citadels, And jackals in their pleasant palaces. Her time [is] near to come, And her days will not be prolonged."
